description.value: The Nanaimo Aquatic Centre is a City of Nanaimo-operated public swimming facility on Third Street in central Nanaimo. As a municipal aquatic centre it serves the full range of recreational swimmers, from drop-in lane swimmers to programmed lessons. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo may find it a useful urban stop for a swim or to access public facilities after a long ride.
